title: Genjutsu Status Durations
body:
Syntax: help genjutsu durations

Description: Genjutsu status effects last much longer than their ordinary equivalents: stun, paralysis, and ringing last 10 seconds; sleep lasts 12; fear, disorientation, confusion, and blindness last 20; soundless, haze, weakness, and Narakumi last 24. Chisei's extra Chakra capacity lasts 60 seconds. An active four-tomoe Sharingan can shorten incoming hostile Genjutsu effects. These are status durations, independent of any damage or cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
